continuous.description: Runs on every host, no external prerequisite.

integration.description: Needs an external dependency. Installed but left disabled when the prerequisite is absent.

invasive.description: Mutates the host. Opt-in per machine.

excluded.description: Deliberately not exercised at runtime. Every entry carries a reason and, where one exists, the unit test that covers it instead.
